skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Stream Above The Clouds
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Stream Above The Clouds. She wakes up atop a cloud in her favorite childhood dress, surrounded by all her friends, and through her daze senses a freedom she hasn't felt in a long time—wait, why's she streaming with her phone?!
skins.quote: 'All my friends watching out there, this is your favorite Streamer U! Look! Check out where I'm coming at you live from! What do you think? This must be that 'cloud streaming' everyone's been talking about lately!'
